Type: wooden saddle-seat stool
Use: seating, small side surface; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, rustic, minimalist
Materials: solid wood, matte painted finish
Colors: black
Shape: rectangular slightly dished seat, four splayed square legs, side and front stretchers, simple and compact, light visual weight
Feel: sturdy, simple, homely
Goes with: white walls, light floors, grey upholstery, natural wood; farmhouse, rustic or modern rooms

Type: leather upholstery swatch

Style: traditional, classic, industrial
Materials: distressed leather-look upholstery, subtle grain
Colors: dark warm brown, oxblood undertone
Shape: flat square sample, crackled grain texture with faint lighter creases, smooth surface
Feel: rich, warm, worn-in
Goes with: dark wood, brass, cream walls, wool rugs; traditional, classic or industrial rooms

Type: herringbone-front sideboard
Use: storage, TV or display surface; living room, dining room
Style: mid-century modern, glam, contemporary
Materials: white lacquered case, limed wood chevron veneer fronts, brass handles and legs
Colors: white, light greige wood, gold
Shape: long low rectangular case, two doors flanking three drawers, chevron pattern, slim tab pulls, thin metal legs, raised and light
Feel: elegant, bright, refined
Goes with: white walls, light wood, brass accents; modern, glam or Scandinavian rooms

Type: low TV media cabinet
Use: TV and media storage; living room, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: white matte case, walnut-look chevron veneer doors, black metal legs
Colors: white, warm dark walnut, black

Shape: long low case, two sliding doors with patchwork wood blocks, open two-tier shelf side, slim gold frame legs, textured front

Type: floating wall-mounted TV shelf
Use: TV and media devices; living room, bedroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern

Colors: pure white
Shape: long wall-hung unit, top shelf with three open compartments, wide lower open shelf, curved sloped side panels, no legs, light and open
Feel: clean, airy, simple
Goes with: white or pale grey walls, light wood floors; minimalist or modern rooms

Type: TV console with cube shelves
Use: TV and media storage, open organizing; living room, bedroom, home office
